```{r}
library(piecewiseSEM)
```


```{r}
forest <- read.table("../data_raw/causalinference_forestdata.txt", header = T)
```


```{r}
forest.model <- lm(forestspeciesabundance ~ protectedarea + distancetoroadsandcities +
elevation + slope, data = forest)

summary(forest.model)
```


```{r}

forest_psem <- psem(
lm(forestspeciesabundance ~ fire + poaching + logging, forest),
lm(carbonsequestration ~ forestspeciesabundance + logging, forest),
lm(logging ~ protectedarea + slope + elevation + distancetoroadsandcities, forest),
lm(fire ~ protectedarea + distancetoroadsandcities, forest),
lm(poaching ~ protectedarea + distancetoroadsandcities, forest),
lm(protectedarea ~ distancetoroadsandcities + slope + elevation, forest)
)

```


```{r}
plot(forest_psem, node_attrs = data.frame(shape = "rectangle", color = "black", fillcolor = "grey"),
layout = "tree")

summary(forest_psem)
```
